items.problem: Agent declared the migration done on a green validator + green smoke launch even though the app crashes when the scorer launches it.
items.evidence: session-log TURN 5 (Test-AppLaunch status=running, pid 18412), TURN 6 (Validate-UwpMigration PASS, smoke pid 28772), TURN 7 ('all checks green, including the smoke launch').
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md line ~130 ('A WinUI 3 app can build cleanly and still crash the instant it starts, so it compiled is not it runs') and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Diagnosing Startup Crashes'.
items.why_no_skill_change: The agent DID run the prescribed launch/validate steps and they genuinely reported PASS — the failure is that those checks cannot reproduce an intermittent startup race, not that the agent skipped guidance. This is addressed by the coverage-gap fixes (static prevention of the fragile pattern), not by telling the agent to 'try harder'. No additional skill edit is warranted for the agent's behaviour itself.
